findings.evidence: Independently verified at src/renderer/src/features/chat/canonical/image-gen-card.tsx:341, where runningStopSentence composes `${running} ${t(...cancel.checking)}` with a hard-coded ASCII space. In zh-CN both values end in the full-width 。 so the joined line carries a half-width space between two Chinese sentences, which is visibly off in Chinese typography and repeats in every stop-with-settlement state. The two VALUES themselves are correct; nothing in the zh-CN draft needs rewording. The programme already solved this shape once: ui.chat.sidebar.mark_all_read.scope_joined is "{chats} {tokenless}" in en and "{chats}{tokenless}" in zh-CN.
findings.suggested: Key the joiner rather than hard-coding a space (en " ", zh-CN ""), mirroring scope_joined, and pass it through the same t() binding so a language switch repaints it. Not a draft change and not in this audit's edit scope; recorded because it is user-visible.
